members.name: Princess Bridget Tola Ogundipe
members.photoAlt: Princess Bridget Tola Ogundipe, Founder of Walts Foundation
members.bio: Leads the Foundation's vision to restore dignity, safety and opportunity to women, children and widows across rural Nigeria.

members.name: Architect Adewale Sunday Ogundipe
members.photoAlt: Architect Adewale Sunday Ogundipe, President of Walts Foundation
members.bio: Provides strategic direction and operational oversight, helping anchor the Foundation's grassroots programmes in sound governance.

members.name: Engineer Ogundipe Tunbi Ajanlekoko
members.role: IT Programme Manager · Head of Administration
members.photoAlt: Engineer Ogundipe Tunbi Ajanlekoko, IT Programme Manager and Head of Administration of Walts Foundation
members.bio: Leads the Foundation's IT and programme management and heads its administration — keeping records, systems and outreaches organised, documented and running.

members.name: Chief Adeleye Bankole Samuel
members.photoAlt: Chief Adeleye Bankole Samuel, Chief Accountant of Walts Foundation
members.bio: Stewards the Foundation's finances — keeping accounts accurate and transparent, and supporting the compliance donors and partners expect.

members.name: Barrister Abidemi Elukunmi Eluyemi
members.photoAlt: Barrister Abidemi Elukunmi Eluyemi of Walts Foundation
members.bio: Oversees all legal matters — contracts, compliance and regulatory affairs — keeping every programme and partnership on solid legal ground.

members.name: Barrister Samuel Olatunde Olagoke
members.photoAlt: Barrister Samuel Olatunde Olagoke of Walts Foundation
members.bio: Handles the Foundation's legal documentation, filings and agreements — ensuring every partnership and programme is properly covered.

members.name: Ayodele Oluwasegun Moyebi
members.photoAlt: Ayodele Oluwasegun Moyebi, Media of Walts Foundation
members.bio: Leads the Foundation's media — photography, video and storytelling that document every outreach and carry its impact to the world.

patron.name: His Imperial Majesty King Babatunde Adeyeye Enitan Oluwatunmise Ogunwusi
patron.photoAlt: His Imperial Majesty King Babatunde Adeyeye Enitan Oluwatunmise Ogunwusi, the Ooni of Ife and Grand Patron of Walts Foundation
patron.bio: The Ooni of Ife — paramount traditional ruler of Ile-Ife and spiritual leader of the Yoruba people worldwide — lends the Foundation a cultural legitimacy and community standing that opens doors across Nigeria, strengthening its work in reaching underserved populations.
